query: What is the legal labelling status of lecanemab in the EU versus advisory clinical guidance?

pubmed.title: EU marketing authorisation text for lecanemab
pubmed.summary: The EU marketing authorisation sets the legally binding indicated population for lecanemab. Separate clinical practice guidelines may offer advisory recommendations that do not themselves confer legal force.

europe_pmc.title: Professional society guideline on anti-amyloid use
europe_pmc.summary: Society guidelines advise on clinic readiness and monitoring. Guidelines are advisory and distinct from marketing authorisation.

recorded_brief:
## Key Findings
- European guidelines exclude ApoE e4/4 carriers from lecanemab approval.

## Bottom Line
- Follow European guidelines for lecanemab approval eligibility.
